title: Depth of the recursive junta learner
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb{N}$, let a relevant-coordinate finder be given for dimension $n$ and junta size $k$, let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ be a Boolean function, and let $\delta\in(0,1/2]$. If an outcome in the support of the recursive learner's run on $f$ has a decision tree $T$ as its output, then the depth of $T$ is at most $k$.
hypotheses_covered: a relevant-coordinate finder for n and k
a Boolean target function on the n-dimensional sign cube
a learning parameter δ with 0 < δ ≤ 1/2
the outcome lies in the support of the recursive learner's run on the target
the outcome's output is the specified decision tree
